title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: generative-AI skills in Create for GCC and GCC High
summary: Held because the guidance treats an organization assets library as optional although the cited brand kit prerequisites require one, and omits making connected assets searchable. The blanket statement that administrators need no action is not documented. The roadmap facts, licensing statements and listed paths and command are supported.
